articles.summary: TipRanks reported shareholder approval of capital-authority and par-value restructuring measures, with implementation conditions. The report's clock is unconfirmed and the associated filing was published after entry; this same-day date match does not establish pre-entry availability or completed share issuance.

articles.headline: Ohmyswift files post-effective amendment to its $300 million shelf registration
sourceWarnings: Direct main-document retrieval was inaccessible; SEC index, counsel opinion, indexed SEC text and the full filing reproduction were reviewed. The ticker registry was corrected to the current BVI domicile; this snapshot also groups earlier OMH trades under BVI and is not a historical domicile model.
articles.summary: The post-effective amendment updates an existing shelf for corporate changes and the sale of the real estate business. The shelf permits potential future offerings; this amendment registers no additional securities and does not establish a completed $300 million financing. The issuer now identifies its legal domicile as British Virgin Islands.
articles.timestampEvidence: SEC index confirms November 16 acceptance at 17:00:02 Eastern; StockTitan explicitly reports public EDGAR availability at 05:04 PM EST. The later public-availability minute is used.
